html:
Question 4
?

Which of the following is equivalent to the integral ∫C(x+y)ds, where C is the section of the polar curve r=sin⁡θ for 0≤θ≤π2?

a
∫0π/2sin⁡θ(sin⁡θ+cos⁡θ)dθ
b
2∫0π/2cos⁡θ(sin⁡θ+cos⁡θ)dθ
c
∫0πcos⁡θ(sin⁡θ+cos⁡θ)dθ
d
2∫0π/2(sin⁡θ+cos⁡θ)dθ
e
∫0π(sin⁡θ+cos⁡θ)dθ
Submit
